recipe.title: Plan settlement reconciliation exception coverage
recipe.scenario: An operations team has open reconciliation exceptions ahead of close. Propose a work order using an authoritative read-only extract. The planner never confirms a match, posts a journal, releases a payout, or makes a financial determination.

field.name: open-exceptions
field.description: Opaque case ID, workspace or account-role label, owner-provided exception type, revision, settlement batch reference, ready-at and due-by UTC timestamps, and estimated review minutes. No account numbers or payment amounts are required.

field.name: confirmed-inputs
field.description: Per case, whether the expected processor report, bank feed or other upstream artifact is available, current, and approved for the owning team. A missing report cannot be treated as a reconciled account.

field.name: team-capacity
field.description: Team or reviewer reference, permitted exception types and account-role scope, remaining minutes per window, pinned items, and any required independent checker window.

field.name: close-windows
field.description: Workspace or ledger-role label, externally supplied closing cutoff, calendar/time basis, and administrative escalation owner.

field.name: snapshot-max-age-minutes
field.description: Largest acceptable age of the source snapshot at allocation time. Do not compare timestamps when the source version or timezone is unresolved.

field.name: proposed-exception-plan
field.description: Case reference, proposed reviewer and checker if required, UTC review windows and closing cutoff. Preserve separation of duties where requested and leave unfinished workload visible.

field.name: review-holds
field.description: Case reference and reason such as input incomplete, stale snapshot, no authorized reviewer, checker unavailable, or cutoff cannot be met. Keep the original accounting state unchanged.
